methods.purpose: inspect continuity around fast layout transitions

methods.caveat: algorithmic candidates, not confirmed shot count

timestamped_findings.finding: Full-bleed pairs skating keeps both bodies and motion visible. A large white Chinese premise sits upper-left with smaller English below; creator mark remains upper-right.
timestamped_findings.limits: Exact font, margins, and transition start are not measured production parameters.

timestamped_findings.finding: A bright blurred flash leads to a repeated GOAT-pattern black background and a tilted portrait inset; 10 fps samples show blur resolving into the inset.
timestamped_findings.limits: No sound listening, so no claim that the flash lands on music or an effect.

timestamped_findings.finding: Several overlapping archival windows slide/occlude one another while small identity labels appear. Continuous geometry change explains why scene detection emits candidates here.
timestamped_findings.limits: Do not label these all as camera cuts or continuous zooms; source layers and edit project are unavailable.

timestamped_findings.finding: A second bright/blurred transition resolves to a full-frame pair portrait.
timestamped_findings.limits: Transition duration is bounded only by 10 fps visual samples.

timestamped_findings.finding: The opening moves from paired portrait to alternating close-ups with bottom-centered subtitles; this creates a premise-to-character sequence within the first eight seconds.
timestamped_findings.limits: 2 fps sampling is not enough to report every cut or exact shot length.

useful_for: 人物故事开头把事件动作、关系命题、人物面孔依次建立的结构研究
do_not_copy_into: 赛场之上的球路/站位解释
需要保持比分牌和完整球员身体的主机位
applicability.reason: Tilted overlapping windows and flash/blur can obscure ball path, body orientation, or scoreboard; one-author evidence cannot become a general rule.

strategy_decision.reason: This is a single-author partial opening review and mainly strengthens an inapplicability boundary. Existing pending experiments remain higher priority; no production skill promotion.
